label: Week 31, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for AI policy, with 8 bill movements and 11 case updates recorded between July 27 and August 2, 2026. Activity was concentrated at the federal level, with 6 items tied to the United States Congress and 2 to Massachusetts, along with 1 federal document and 1 mention of the Health and Human Services Department. Three bills did not fall under any tracked theme.

Among themed bills, criminal law led with 3, covering new offenses, penalties, and evidence rules for AI-related conduct, as in United States Congress HB9963. Elections followed with 2, touching AI-generated political content and disclosure rules, exemplified by SB5135. Single bills touched children and minors, employment and hiring, government use, and health care, including HB9948 on agency AI procurement and health care decision support. No bill is reported as passed, only as having a status change.
